424B2 1 d150456d424b2.htm 424B2 424B2 Filed Pursuant to Rule 424(b)(2) Registration No. 333-283760 Prospectus Supplement (To Prospectus dated December 12, 2024) $25,000,000,000 Microsoft Corporation $1,000,000,000 Floating Rate Notes due 2028 $2,000,000,000 4.850% Notes due 2028 $1,000,000,000 Floating Rate Notes due 2029 $3,250,000,000 5.000% Notes due 2029 $3,250,000,000 5.200% Notes due 2031 $2,500,000,000 5.350% Notes due 2033 $4,000,000,000 5.550% Notes due 2036 $2,000,000,000 6.150% Notes due 2046 $4,000,000,000 6.250% Notes due 2056 $2,000,000,000 6.350% Notes due 2066 We are offering $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of Floating Rate Notes due 2028 (the “2028 Floating Rate Notes”), $2,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.850% Notes due 2028 (the “2028 Notes”), $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of Floating Rate Notes due 2029 (the “2029 Floating Rate Notes” and, together with the 2028 Floating Rate Notes, the “floating rate notes”), $3,250,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.000% Notes due 2029 (the “2029 Notes”), $3,250,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.200% Notes due 2031 (the “2031 Notes”), $2,500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.350% Notes due 2033 (the “2033 Notes”), $4,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.550% Notes due 2036 (the “2036 Notes”), $2,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 6.150% Notes due 2046 (the “2046 Notes”), $4,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 6.250% Notes due 2056 (the “2056 Notes”) and $2,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 6.350% Notes due 2066 (the “2066 Notes” and, together with the 2028 Notes, the 2029 Notes, the 2031 Notes, the 2033 Notes, the 2036 Notes, the 2046 Notes and the 2056 Notes, the “fixed rate notes” and the fixed rate notes, collectively with the floating rate notes, the “notes”). The 2028 Floating Rate Notes will bear interest at a floating rate, reset quarterly, equal to Compounded SOFR (as defined herein) plus 35 basis points (0.350%) per annum. The 2029 Floating Rate Notes will bear interest at a floating rate, reset quarterly, equal to Compounded SOFR plus 53 basis points (0.530%) per annum. Interest on the floating rate notes will accrue from November 4, 2026 and be payable quarterly in arrears on February 3, May 3, August 3 and November 3 of each year, beginning on February 3, 2027. Interest on the fixed rate notes will accrue from November 4, 2026 and be payable semi-annually in arrears on May 3 and November 3 of each year, beginning on May 3, 2027.
